fix.q: The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement, signed in April 2026, came into force on which date?
fix.explanation: The India-New Zealand FTA came into force on 20 October 2026, after both countries ratified it. It was signed on 27 April 2026 and gives 100% of India's exports duty-free access to New Zealand. New Zealand has committed to facilitate USD 20 billion of investment in India over 15 years. Source: MFAT (New Zealand), Oct 2026; IBEF, Sep 2026.

fix.q: Which country will host COP32, the UN climate change conference, in 2027?
fix.explanation: Ethiopia will host COP32 in Addis Ababa in 2027. It won the African Group's backing over Nigeria, and the choice was announced at COP30 in Belem, Brazil, in November 2025. COP31 is being held in Antalya, Turkiye (9-20 November 2026), with Australia leading the negotiations. The UNFCCC secretariat is in Bonn, Germany. Source: Reuters via The Star, 11 Nov 2025; UNFCCC, Nov 2026.
